articles.title: SoFi, Kraken tie up as crypto and banking push into each other's turf
articles.snippet: Kraken is joining SoFi's settlement network and list SoFiUSD as the companies link traditional banking with crypto markets.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin jumps above $81,000 as rates fall, dollar weakens
articles.snippet: The government's employment data (due tomorrow) is usually the main economic report of the month, but this time around it's next week's inflation numbers that will decide Fed policy.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s fabled golden cross is coming. And USDT may be the real signal this time
articles.snippet: BTC is nearing a bullish golden cross, a widely tracked signal with a mixed record of success in crypto markets. But this time, USDT is supporting the bullish read.

articles.title: Crypto made new friends in U.S. primaries, but focus now shifts to general election
articles.snippet: Adding Massachusetts incumbent Auchincloss to the list of winning primary candidates Fairshake supported, the industry's influence moves on to November.

articles.title: New Jersey becomes first state to ask Supreme Court to weigh in on prediction markets
articles.snippet: After multiple appeals courts ruled differently about whether states can crack down on prediction markets' sports products, New Jersey asked SCOTUS to step in.
